title: Pan-Seared Snapper with Garlic
description: A simple and flavorful dish that showcases the delicate flavor of snapper. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the snapper for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the snapper is baking, mix together minced garlic and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the garlic-lemon mixture over the snapper.
Serve immediately, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
